visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short hair wearing a black t-shirt stands in a modern kitchen with glossy white cabinets and a marble countertop. He looks down at a paper with red text on the counter with a confused expression. (2) He picks up the paper and stares at it intently, his eyes widening in surprise as the camera moves to a close-up of his face. (3) The camera shows the paper in his hands, displaying a collaboration logo with the 'Attack on Titan' title in traditional Chinese. (4) The man places his hand over his forehead in a dramatic, pained pose, squinting his eyes as if in deep thought or distress. (5) A rapid montage occurs with extreme close-ups of the man's hair, ear, and skin, with a text overlay centered in the frame. (6) Brief clips of a dark-haired animated character appear, followed by a close-up of the man's eye reflecting a golden light. (7) The man looks directly into the camera with a fierce, determined glare while digital ember/fire effects float across the screen. (8) The man is suddenly shown from a low angle, upside down, with a plastic dental mouth-stretcher in his mouth, exposing his teeth and gums. (9) The screen cuts to black with large red characters in the center.
